name: @xurunxin/morpheus-protocol-workspace
description: Morpheus 版本化协议与应用 SDK 开发仓库

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun x tsc -b --force && bun build packages/morpheus-protocol/src/index.ts --outdir packages/morpheus-protocol/dist --target browser --format esm && bun build packages/morpheus-sdk/src/index.ts --outdir packages/morpheus-sdk/dist --target browser --format esm --external @xurunxin/morpheus-protocol
scripts.test: bun test && bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:dependencies
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.verify:full: bun run verify && bun run test:packed-consumer
scripts.release:check: bun run verify:full && bun run pack && bun run check:version
